info.name: ION Starter Kit Buyer App
info.description: ION buyer-side requests generated from release flow examples.

request.description: Storefront discover — BAP searches for Pepperoni Pizza within 2 km of a location in South Jakarta.
Storefront discover — BAP searches the ION catalog for Domino's Pizza providers at postal code 12190.
Storefront discover — BAP searches the ION catalog for a large pepperoni pizza.
B2C-SF select — BAP sends item selection. Beckn v2.0 SelectAction shape. Note: example uses generic item IDs; replace with your actual resource and offer IDs.

Storefront init — BAP provides delivery address and payment method. QRIS payment, delivery to South Jakarta. The payment settlement is the order's IONSettlementReconciliation: the BAP proposes a 3% finder fee on the item total, declares its own payout account for it, and estimates the figures on the on_select quote.
Storefront confirm — BAP confirms order after payment. Binding commit.
Storefront status — BAP requests the current state of the confirmed pizza order.
Storefront track — BAP requests a real-time tracking handle for the confirmed pizza order.
Storefront rate — after full delivery, the BAP submits a 4-out-of-5 rating for the pepperoni pizza resource.
Storefront cancel preview — BAP previews cancelling the order for a change of mind shortly after confirmation, before packing or shipment.
Storefront cancel — BAP commits the previously previewed free cancellation before the order is packed or shipped.
Storefront update preview — BAP previews revised buyer delivery instructions without committing the change.
Storefront update — BAP commits the previewed buyer delivery instruction changes.
Storefront grievance — the buyer reports that the delivered pizza arrived crushed. The BAP opens grievance GRV-2026-00004400 against the seller.
Storefront grievance — the buyer agrees, and the BAP accepts version 1 of the proposal as a whole.

Storefront reconcile — after delivery the BPP (seller app) sends its settlement figures for the confirmed QRIS order. The PJP holds 98790; the BPP claims 96120 and the BAP's 3% finder fee on the 89000 item total is 2670.
